concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished character-and-traversal art direction sheet for JUSTME using the supplied approved cover illustration as the source of truth. The SAME small red-haired female protagonist, teal dress and cream details, large turquoise eyes, small dark shoes, long red hair, delicate recognizable silhouette. Anime-inspired hand-painted 2D game character, about 3 heads tall, tender and cute but fierce, untamed and determined through posture and expression; not sexualized, not animal-eared, no weapons. Worn cloth and modest hand wraps may suggest survival; preserve her core identity, no unrelated redesign. Landscape studio concept sheet on muted warm-gray paper, no scenery wallpaper covering the sheet. Left: one large crisp full-body 3/4 character standing and one smaller exact side view, same proportions. Right: six readable key poses for game animation: powerful forward-leaning run with opposing arms/legs, ground-jump push-off, distinctly tucked midair double-jump/air-kick, hand-over-hand rope climbing with bent knees and feet pinching the rope, hanging from a stone ledge with hands physically planted, pulling the torso above the ledge. Hands and feet visibly make believable contact, rope stays fixed to its anchor and body moves around real grips; no levitating idle pose disguised as climbing. Bottom: matching material studies of slender braided hemp rope with irregular fiber, a weathered iron hook set into stone, and a chipped load-bearing stone cornice with a small cloth remnant; game-readable shapes, NO red buttons, circular glowing indicators or artificial pegs. Show these as distinct illustration studies, not animations or a sprite atlas. Painterly linework matching the reference, mossy stone, aged wood, muted teal, cream, rusty iron, chestnut rope, red hair as the main accent. A few concise Spanish labels only: 'TIERNA · INDÓMITA', 'CORRER', 'SALTO', 'DOBLE SALTO', 'TREPAR', 'AGARRE', 'SUBIR', 'CUERDA Y CORNISA'. No logos or watermark. This is a visual concept for approval, not a finished animation sheet.
animationAtlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE clean RGBA game animation sprite atlas for the EXACT red-haired teal-dressed protagonist in this reference concept sheet. Preserve the same face, turquoise eyes, red hair, cream collar, worn teal dress, modest hand wraps and dark ankle shoes. Cute but fierce, 3-head-tall hand-painted anime 2D side-scroller character. TECHNICAL LAYOUT: exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 frames, on a 1536 by 1024 transparent canvas. Every cell 256 by 256. NO labels, letters, numbering, borders, grid lines, shadows on the ground, scenery, rope, stone ledge, props, particles or checkerboard. Truly transparent empty pixels. Each cell contains one whole character, side view facing RIGHT. Fixed camera, identical head size, body scale, costume and color across ALL frames; do not enlarge crouched or airborne figures to fill cells. Registration: pelvis center stays at the same cell coordinate x=50%, y=58% from the top in every frame; head size about 14% of cell height; normal standing soles near 90% cell height. Allow limbs/hair to articulate around that fixed pelvis; leave generous transparent margins so no frame touches a neighbor. ROW 1, left to right: six consecutive evenly spaced phases of one powerful running cycle, low forward lean, clear contact/down/passing/up phases, opposing arms and legs, hair and hem follow through, last phase flows into first. ROW 2: six consecutive phases of grounded-jump animation: anticipation crouch, toe push-off, full extension, rising tucked legs, apex open pose, downward landing anticipation; clearly not a run cycle. ROW 3: six consecutive phases of a DISTINCT midair double jump: sudden compact tuck, strong knee lift with arms gathering, quick side-on twisting air-kick, hair whip following the twist, unfolding legs, controlled descent pose. Keep pelvis registered and face recognizable; no total silhouette-changing costume drift. ROW 4: six consecutive phases of believable hand-over-hand rope climbing facing right, gripping an INVISIBLE fixed rope line at x=66% of each cell, one hand stays planted while the other reaches above it, knees alternate and feet pinch the rope, torso pulls toward that hand then settles. The sequence must alternate limb contacts; never duplicate a standing pose translated upward. No rope drawn: it will be supplied as a separate world object in Unity. All 24 poses should be different but anatomically coherent and retain one exact model. Crisp readable silhouettes, stable contours, painterly finish consistent with reference. This is a draft animation atlas for visual evaluation, not a concept poster.
